title: Unit Event — Little Bravers! — Episode5 To Shake Their Hearts

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need continues to get their name out there as more people begin watching their videos and coming to see their shows. Then, someone from a record company appears before them and suggests that they put on their very own solo show...!

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry for running late...
I know we're supposed to work on stuff for our show today... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why's the blackboard covered in notes...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There you are, Shiho!
You're late!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Shiho. We've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What are you all doing...?
I thought we were gonna work on stuff for our show today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Actually...
Honami gave us some ideas regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You want to ask other people to help us make fliers, CDs, advertisements and everything else not related to our practice...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Before, I wasn't too sure about asking others to help us with those things...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I don't think we have time to worry about that now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because we've been practicing and preparing for our show at the same time, we've begun exhausting ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I definitely understand the desire to do everything right for our very first solo show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was of the same mind, so I tried to come up with ways in which I could do all the work we need to do myself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, I realized that it wasn't realistic since I also had to practice. And it wouldn't be good for a single band member to carry such a load...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That was when I ran into Kiritani.
She taught me what's most important about doing a solo show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's most important?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
First...
The audience needs to enjoy our performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Remember what our goal is?
It's to play music that really moves people's hearts, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, for our solo show, we should strive to do just that and even more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
In order to accomplish that...
We need to do every last thing we can. That's why I made the suggestion I did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We need to prioritize practicing and finishing our new song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, let's ask the people around us for help regarding everything else.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My plan is to ask my friends, classmates... and my family as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Hona, you're gonna ask your family?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. They're self-employed, so I have a feeling that they'll be able to give us some advice regarding our finances and how to negotiate deals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll do all the asking of course, so there's no need to worry. For now, please focus on practicing and finishing our song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But won't that be asking too much of you, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like for you all to focus on how to make our show fun for our guests.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be better to just be able to practice and work on our song without having to spend time and energy on preparations for our show?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please help us! We could really use a hand!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We want our first solo show to be a success, no matter what...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
We'll be more than happy to lend you girls a hand.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's no way we're about to leave our beloved juniors hanging.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But can I ask one thing...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you mentioned what's most important about doing solo shows, you began by saying, “First...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does that mean there's something else?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should enjoy this solo show to the fullest ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Though, I'm just relaying what my friend suggested...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, we should also try to enjoy this process.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I can't wait to see how we're gonna help♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All the things we need to do in order to put on the best show we can, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If Hona's willing to say this much, then we gotta do our best too...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's all do our best while also having fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, Ichika, Saki...
Starting today, please focus only on practicing and finishing our song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, can I ask you to help me reorganize our schedule?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you want me to make a flyer for Leo/need?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I was hoping that you would since I heard that you have some experience doing this...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm not that experienced...
But I'd be happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You would?!
Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to ask you right away if it'd be possible to make one that shows who we are as a band at first glance...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
At first glance...?
Hehe. It won't be easy, but it should be a fun challenge.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right... I came across some really nice fliers during the last event I went to and made sure to take photos of them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why don't we take a look at them and come up with a more concrete concept together? I'll start working on your band's flyer once we've made a decision.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'd like me to put together a website for Leo/need?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...! We'd like to have one where people can reserve tickets. I know this is very sudden, but would you be willing to help...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honami asked me yesterday if I knew someone who could handle this favor. Which is when you came to mind!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it shouldn't take too long...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Then, if you don't mind...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I apologize... I know this is really our business, but it's our very first solo show and we were starting to feel a bit overwhelmed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know much about what it's like to be in a band, but I understand that putting on a show all by yourselves is no small task...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, exactly...
Saki and the others are also working incredibly hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Our original plan was to do all of these things on our own, but we've been having to cut back on practice to do so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In order for us to put on the best performance we can for our audience, I'd like for them to focus on our music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I know I'm asking a lot of you, but we really need your help...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll be more than happy to lend a hand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, putting on a good performance is a team effort.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, let's go with this introduction.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I like it. It's very Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Then, I'll set up an account and post it right away.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! First the official Leo/need channel, and now the official Leo/need account♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, that sets the foundation for us to advertise for our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget. I need to reply to the email the manager sent... After that, I need to get back to practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, Honami.
When do you think you'll be ready to join us for practice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I should be okay in about five minutes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
In the meantime, we'll do another quick run.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The others are looking pretty solid now, so all that's left is you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'll do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Shiho's pressuring Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Honami.
Shiho came up with a special practice regimen just for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you did?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey...!
Didn't I tell you two to stay in the classroom?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we couldn't wait any longer♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've been able to practice and work on our new song, but we've had less time to practice as a full band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But things are coming along nicely thanks to you, Honami. We're really grateful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're all very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They seem to be doing well now.
Nothing like how they were when they first began preparing for their solo show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami's efforts are having such a positive effect on the others...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree.
It makes sense since she likes to be there for others...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it's so cool to see how she's carrying the band now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You should really tell her that directly.
I'm sure she'd appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'll wait.
I'd rather not ruin their groove.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's cool how you've become such a good senior to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...? Th-That wasn't what I was going for...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. You're blushing so much.
